copy.mediumDescription: RatPDF (https://ratpdf.com) is a privacy-focused online PDF platform for compressing, merging, splitting, converting (PDF to Word/Excel/PowerPoint/text/images), OCR on scanned PDFs, signing, watermarking, and password protection. Built on Ghostscript, LibreOffice, pdf2docx, PyMuPDF, and Tesseract. Free tier: 3 uses per tool per day, 200 MB uploads, HTTPS, files deleted after download. Pro unlocks unlimited daily use and 4 GB uploads. Also includes GST/VAT invoice generators and 600+ workflow guides.
copy.longDescription:
RatPDF is a browser-based document productivity platform offering free and Pro PDF tools for everyday document work. Users can compress PDFs for email and web uploads, merge and split documents, convert between PDF and Office formats, extract text from scanned files with OCR, add typed signatures and watermarks, password-protect or unlock PDFs, and flatten forms — all without installing desktop software.

Unlike many PDF sites, RatPDF publishes original research (email attachment size limits, PDF compression benchmarks) and detailed comparison guides vs iLovePDF, Smallpdf, Adobe, PDF24, and Sejda. Processing runs on secure cloud servers; files are encrypted in transit and deleted after download on the free tier.

Ideal for students, freelancers, SMBs, accountants, and legal teams who need reliable PDF utilities with transparent limits. Founded 2024. Editorial team: Ethan Brooks (Editor-in-Chief), Priya Sharma (Business documents), James Cole (Security).
